result:
I updated `rails`, `actionpack` and `activestorage` from 7.0.8 to 7.0.10, which is above the 7.0.8.1 target. I did not run the test suite or start the app, so nothing has been tested.

- **Rails components:** `bundle update rails --conservative` moved all the Rails components to 7.0.10 in `Gemfile.lock`. That includes `activesupport`, `activerecord`, `actionview`, `activejob`, `actioncable`, `actionmailer`, `actionmailbox`, `actiontext` and `railties`.
- **Gemfile:** I changed the Rails line from `"~> 7.0.7"` to `"~> 7.0.8", ">= 7.0.8.1"`. That constraint keeps the app on the 7.0 series and stops it from resolving back to the vulnerable 7.0.8.
- **Other gems:** The lockfile diff is larger than the Rails components alone (74 lines added, 58 removed). I didn't review it, so some non-Rails gems may have moved as dependencies. Check `git diff Gemfile.lock` before committing.

I didn't confirm the exact CVE/GHSA identifiers from the Dependabot alerts.
